Core

Badge

Small status pill with a dot. Class contract: .rse-badge--<tone>.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

Small status pill with a dot indicator — enrollment status, availability, alerts.

<Badge tone="success">Vagas abertas</Badge>
<Badge tone="warning">Últimas vagas</Badge>
<Badge tone="danger">Encerrado</Badge>

Tones: success, warning, danger, info, neutral, primary.

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
tonesuccess warning danger info neutral primary—
childrenReact.ReactNodeyes

Also accepts every attribute of React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, a ref and className.
